title: BattleReadyShelf Wargear Definition Export
description:
The authoritative contract for the JSON document accepted by POST /api/v1/admin/wargear-definitions/import (and produced by GET /api/v1/admin/wargear-definitions/export). This is the canonical source of truth for this contract - other repositories producing an import document (e.g. battlereadyshelf-dataset) must conform to it. It mirrors the 'WargearDefinitionExport' schema in backend/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml; if the two ever disagree, the OpenAPI spec wins and this file should be updated to match.

Wargear is the second of the three definition documents to import: model definitions reference wargear by the ids named here, so importing models before wargear is rejected.

Each item is named once. A model definition that carries the item references it by id and does not repeat the name, which is what makes renaming an item update every model that uses it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this export document's schema. Must be within the backend's supported range (see ExportSchema) or the import is rejected. All three definition documents share one version.

exportedAt.description: Set by the backend on export; ignored if present on import.

datasetVersion.description: Optional version of the source dataset assembled into this document.

wargear.description: The shared wargear catalogue. New ids are created on import; an id whose name differs from the stored one is staged as a proposed rename for an admin to accept or reject, because one definition backs every model carrying that item and an unattended rename would fan out across the catalogue.

id.description: Stable identifier used to match this wargear across imports and referenced by model definitions. Sourced from the reference dataset; exports of hand-authored wargear emit the persisted UUID instead.
